import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode

/-- All directed edges read out of the adjacency list, as `MSTEdge`s. -/
def mkEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap fun u =>
    (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map fun p => ⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩

/-- Union-Find as a flat label array: `c[i]` is the representative of `i`. -/
def UFfind (c : Array Nat) (u : Nat) : Nat := c.getD u u

/-- Merge the class of `v` into the class of `u`. -/
def UFunion (c : Array Nat) (u v : Nat) : Array Nat :=
  let ru := UFfind c u
  let rv := UFfind c v
  c.map fun x => if x = rv then ru else x

/-- The Kruskal scan: walk the weight-sorted edge list, keeping an edge exactly
when its endpoints currently lie in different components.  Returns the final
Union-Find state together with the kept edges. -/
def kruskalRun : List MSTEdge → Array Nat → List MSTEdge → Array Nat × List MSTEdge
  | [], c, acc => (c, acc.reverse)
  | e :: es, c, acc =>
      if UFfind c e.u = UFfind c e.v then kruskalRun es c acc
      else kruskalRun es (UFunion c e.u e.v) (e :: acc)

def kruskalGo (es : List MSTEdge) (c : Array Nat) (acc : List MSTEdge) : List MSTEdge :=
  (kruskalRun es c acc).2

/-- The set of distinct component labels among the first `n` vertices. -/
def labelSet (n : Nat) (c : Array Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  (Finset.range n).image (fun i => UFfind c i)

/-- Reachability in the undirected graph spanned by a list of edges. -/
def Reach (S : List MSTEdge) : Nat → Nat → Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (fun a b => edges_contain S a b)

/-- Sort all graph edges by ascending weight. -/
def sortedEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (mkEdges g).mergeSort (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))

/-- Initial Union-Find state: every vertex is its own representative. -/
def initUF (n : Nat) : Array Nat := Array.ofFn (n := n) (fun i => i.val)

-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definition
def kruskal_mst (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : List MSTEdge :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  kruskalGo (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def kruskal_mst_postcond (graph : WeightedGraph) (result : List MSTEdge)
    (_ : kruskal_mst_precond graph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  is_mst graph result
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma

/-- Every edge produced by `mkEdges` really occurs in the adjacency list. -/
theorem mkEdges_valid {g : WeightedGraph} {e : MSTEdge} (he : e ∈ mkEdges g) :
    e.is_valid g := by
  unfold mkEdges at he
  rw [List.mem_flatMap] at he
  obtain ⟨u, hu, he⟩ := he
  rw [List.mem_map] at he
  obtain ⟨p, hp, rfl⟩ := he
  rw [List.mem_range] at hu
  exact ⟨hu, p, Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hp, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- `UFunion` is an `Array.map`, so it preserves the size. -/
theorem UFunion_size (c : Array Nat) (u v : Nat) : (UFunion c u v).size = c.size := by
  simp [UFunion]

/-- The single computational fact about `UFunion`: it relabels exactly the class of `v`. -/
theorem UFfind_union {c : Array Nat} {u v x : Nat} (hx : x < c.size) :
    UFfind (UFunion c u v) x =
      if UFfind c x = UFfind c v then UFfind c u else UFfind c x := by
  have hs : (UFunion c u v).size = c.size := UFunion_size c u v
  simp [UFfind, UFunion, Array.getD, hx, Array.getElem_map]

/-- After a union the two merged endpoints share a label. -/
theorem UFunion_merges {c : Array Nat} {u v : Nat} (hu : u < c.size) (hv : v < c.size) :
    UFfind (UFunion c u v) u = UFfind (UFunion c u v) v := by
  rw [UFfind_union hu, UFfind_union hv]
  by_cases h : UFfind c u = UFfind c v <;> simp [h]

/-- Labels only ever merge: an equality of labels survives every union. -/
theorem UFunion_mono {c : Array Nat} {u v a b : Nat} (ha : a < c.size) (hb : b < c.size)
    (h : UFfind c a = UFfind c b) :
    UFfind (UFunion c u v) a = UFfind (UFunion c u v) b := by
  rw [UFfind_union ha, UFfind_union hb, h]

/-- Backward half of the "labels = components" invariant. -/
theorem UFunion_cases {c : Array Nat} {u v a b : Nat} (ha : a < c.size) (hb : b < c.size)
    (h : UFfind (UFunion c u v) a = UFfind (UFunion c u v) b) :
    UFfind c a = UFfind c b ∨
      (UFfind c a = UFfind c v ∧ UFfind c b = UFfind c u) ∨
      (UFfind c a = UFfind c u ∧ UFfind c b = UFfind c v) := by
  rw [UFfind_union ha, UFfind_union hb] at h
  by_cases h1 : UFfind c a = UFfind c v <;> by_cases h2 : UFfind c b = UFfind c v <;>
    simp [h1, h2] at h ⊢ <;> omega

-- Reachability helpers (`Reach` is a `def`, so dot notation on `ReflTransGen` does not fire).

theorem Reach.refl' (S : List MSTEdge) (a : Nat) : Reach S a a :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.refl

theorem Reach.single' {S : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : edges_contain S a b) : Reach S a b :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.single h

theorem Reach.trans' {S : List MSTEdge} {a b c : Nat} (h1 : Reach S a b) (h2 : Reach S b c) :
    Reach S a c :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

theorem edges_contain_mono {S S' : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e ∈ S, e ∈ S') {a b : Nat}
    (h : edges_contain S a b) : edges_contain S' a b := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hb⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, hs e he, hb⟩

theorem Reach_mono {S S' : List MSTEdge} (hs : ∀ e ∈ S, e ∈ S') {a b : Nat}
    (h : Reach S a b) : Reach S' a b :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.mono (fun _ _ hx => edges_contain_mono hs hx) h

/-- Bridge lemma: the closure `Reach` produces an explicit `path_follows_edges` witness. -/
theorem reach_path {S : List MSTEdge} {u v : Nat} (h : Reach S u v) :
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges S p := by
  induction h using Relation.ReflTransGen.head_induction_on with
  | refl => exact ⟨[v], rfl, rfl, by simp [path_follows_edges]⟩
  | head hab _ ih =>
      rename_i a b _
      obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := ih
      have hpne : p ≠ [] := by
        intro hnil; rw [hnil] at hp1; simp at hp1
      cases p with
      | nil => exact absurd rfl hpne
      | cons x xs =>
        have hx : x = b := by simpa using hp1
        subst hx
        refine ⟨a :: x :: xs, rfl, by simpa using hp2, by simp, ?_⟩
        intro i hi
        match i with
        | 0 => simpa using hab
        | (k + 1) => simpa using hp3.2 k (by simpa using hi)

/-- The scan only ever returns edges it was given. -/
theorem kruskalGo_mem {es : List MSTEdge} {c : Array Nat} {acc : List MSTEdge}
    {e : MSTEdge} (he : e ∈ kruskalGo es c acc) : e ∈ es ∨ e ∈ acc := by
  induction es generalizing c acc with
  | nil => simp [kruskalGo, kruskalRun, List.mem_reverse] at he; exact Or.inr he
  | cons a es ih =>
      unfold kruskalGo kruskalRun at he
      split at he
      · rcases ih he with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
        · exact Or.inr h
      · rcases ih he with h | h
        · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)
        · rcases List.mem_cons.mp h with rfl | h
          · exact Or.inl (List.mem_cons_self ..)
          · exact Or.inr h

theorem mem_sortedEdges {g : WeightedGraph} {e : MSTEdge}
    (he : e ∈ sortedEdges g) : e ∈ mkEdges g :=
  (List.mergeSort_perm (mkEdges g) (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))).subset he

/-- P2: every returned edge is a genuine graph edge. -/
theorem kruskal_valid (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph)
    (e : MSTEdge) (he : e ∈ kruskal_mst graph h) : e.is_valid graph := by
  unfold kruskal_mst at he
  rcases kruskalGo_mem he with h' | h'
  · exact mkEdges_valid (mem_sortedEdges h')
  · simp at h'

theorem edges_contain_symm {S : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : edges_contain S a b) :
    edges_contain S b a := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hb⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, by tauto⟩

theorem Reach_symm {S : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : Reach S a b) : Reach S b a := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Reach.refl' S a
  | tail _ h2 ih => exact Reach.trans' (Reach.single' (edges_contain_symm h2)) ih

/-- Membership in the label set. -/
theorem mem_labelSet {n : Nat} {c : Array Nat} {i : Nat} (hi : i < n) :
    UFfind c i ∈ labelSet n c := by
  simp only [labelSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
  exact ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩

/-- A union removes exactly the class of `v` from the label set. -/
theorem labelSet_union {n : Nat} {c : Array Nat} {u v : Nat} (hu : u < n) (_hv : v < n)
    (hc : c.size = n) (h : UFfind c u ≠ UFfind c v) :
    labelSet n (UFunion c u v) = (labelSet n c).erase (UFfind c v) := by
  ext x
  simp only [labelSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_erase]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
    rw [UFfind_union (by omega : i < c.size)]
    by_cases hh : UFfind c i = UFfind c v
    · rw [if_pos hh]
      exact ⟨h, u, hu, rfl⟩
    · rw [if_neg hh]
      exact ⟨hh, i, hi, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨hx, i, hi, rfl⟩
    refine ⟨i, hi, ?_⟩
    rw [UFfind_union (by omega : i < c.size), if_neg hx]

theorem labelSet_card_union {n : Nat} {c : Array Nat} {u v : Nat} (hu : u < n) (hv : v < n)
    (hc : c.size = n) (h : UFfind c u ≠ UFfind c v) :
    (labelSet n (UFunion c u v)).card + 1 = (labelSet n c).card := by
  have hmem : UFfind c v ∈ labelSet n c := mem_labelSet hv
  have hpos : 0 < (labelSet n c).card := Finset.card_pos.mpr ⟨_, hmem⟩
  rw [labelSet_union hu hv hc h, Finset.card_erase_of_mem hmem]
  omega

/-- The unified scan invariant: size, the "kept + components = n" count, the
component-to-reachability bridge, the fact that every scanned edge ends merged,
and monotonicity of the labelling. -/
theorem kruskalRun_inv (n : Nat) :
    ∀ (es : List MSTEdge) (c : Array Nat) (acc : List MSTEdge),
      c.size = n → (∀ e ∈ es, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) →
      acc.length + (labelSet n c).card = n →
      (∀ a b, a < n → b < n → UFfind c a = UFfind c b → Reach acc a b) →
      (kruskalRun es c acc).1.size = n ∧
      (kruskalRun es c acc).2.length + (labelSet n (kruskalRun es c acc).1).card = n ∧
      (∀ a b, a < n → b < n →
        UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 a = UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 b →
        Reach (kruskalRun es c acc).2 a b) ∧
      (∀ e ∈ es, UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 e.u = UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 e.v) ∧
      (∀ a b, a < n → b < n → UFfind c a = UFfind c b →
        UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 a = UFfind (kruskalRun es c acc).1 b) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil =>
      intro c acc hsz _ hcard hreach
      have hrun : kruskalRun ([] : List MSTEdge) c acc = (c, acc.reverse) := rfl
      rw [hrun]
      refine ⟨hsz, by simpa using hcard, ?_, by simp, fun a b _ _ h => h⟩
      intro a b ha hb h
      exact Reach_mono (fun e he => by simpa using he) (hreach a b ha hb h)
  | cons e es ih =>
      intro c acc hsz hb hcard hreach
      obtain ⟨heu, hev⟩ := hb e (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      have hbes : ∀ f ∈ es, f.u < n ∧ f.v < n := fun f hf => hb f (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf)
      by_cases hg : UFfind c e.u = UFfind c e.v
      · have hrun : kruskalRun (e :: es) c acc = kruskalRun es c acc := by
          simp only [kruskalRun, if_pos hg]
        rw [hrun]
        obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5⟩ := ih c acc hsz hbes hcard hreach
        refine ⟨i1, i2, i3, ?_, i5⟩
        intro f hf
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf
        · exact i5 f.u f.v heu hev hg
        · exact i4 f hf
      · have hrun : kruskalRun (e :: es) c acc
            = kruskalRun es (UFunion c e.u e.v) (e :: acc) := by
          simp only [kruskalRun, if_neg hg]
        rw [hrun]
        have hsz' : (UFunion c e.u e.v).size = n := by rw [UFunion_size]; exact hsz
        have hcard' : (e :: acc).length + (labelSet n (UFunion c e.u e.v)).card = n := by
          have := labelSet_card_union (c := c) heu hev hsz hg
          simp only [List.length_cons]
          omega
        have hreach' : ∀ a b, a < n → b < n →
            UFfind (UFunion c e.u e.v) a = UFfind (UFunion c e.u e.v) b → Reach (e :: acc) a b := by
          intro a b ha hbn h
          have hstep : edges_contain (e :: acc) e.v e.u :=
            ⟨e, List.mem_cons_self .., Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩⟩
          have hmono : ∀ x y, Reach acc x y → Reach (e :: acc) x y :=
            fun x y hxy => Reach_mono (fun f hf => List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hf) hxy
          rcases UFunion_cases (by omega : a < c.size) (by omega : b < c.size) h with
            h1 | ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
          · exact hmono a b (hreach a b ha hbn h1)
          · exact Reach.trans' (hmono a e.v (hreach a e.v ha hev h1))
              (Reach.trans' (Reach.single' hstep)
                (Reach_symm (hmono b e.u (hreach b e.u hbn heu h2))))
          · exact Reach.trans' (hmono a e.u (hreach a e.u ha heu h1))
              (Reach.trans' (Reach_symm (Reach.single' hstep))
                (Reach_symm (hmono b e.v (hreach b e.v hbn hev h2))))
        obtain ⟨i1, i2, i3, i4, i5⟩ := ih (UFunion c e.u e.v) (e :: acc) hsz' hbes hcard' hreach'
        refine ⟨i1, i2, i3, ?_, ?_⟩
        · intro f hf
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hf with rfl | hf
          · exact i5 f.u f.v heu hev (UFunion_merges (by omega) (by omega))
          · exact i4 f hf
        · intro a b ha hbn h
          exact i5 a b ha hbn (UFunion_mono (by omega) (by omega) h)

/-- Generic chain principle: an index-based path witnesses a reflexive-transitive relation. -/
theorem chain_of_path {R : Nat → Nat → Prop} (hrefl : ∀ a, R a a)
    (htrans : ∀ a b c, R a b → R b c → R a c) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat), (∀ i, i + 1 < p.length → R (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)) →
      ∀ x y, p.head? = some x → p.getLast? = some y → R x y := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro _ x y hx _; simp at hx
  | cons a t ih =>
      intro hstep x y hx hy
      have hax : a = x := by simpa using hx
      subst hax
      cases t with
      | nil =>
          have hay : a = y := by simpa using hy
          subst hay
          exact hrefl a
      | cons b t' =>
          have h0 : R a b := by simpa using hstep 0 (by simp)
          have hstep' : ∀ i, i + 1 < (b :: t').length → R ((b :: t').getD i 0)
              ((b :: t').getD (i + 1) 0) := by
            intro i hi
            simpa using hstep (i + 1) (by simpa using hi)
          have hy' : (b :: t').getLast? = some y := by simpa using hy
          exact htrans a b y h0 (ih hstep' b y rfl hy')

/-- Every graph edge appears in `mkEdges`. -/
theorem mem_mkEdges {g : WeightedGraph} {u v : Nat} {w : Int} (h : g.has_edge u v w) :
    (⟨u, v, w⟩ : MSTEdge) ∈ mkEdges g := by
  obtain ⟨hu, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := h
  refine List.mem_flatMap.mpr ⟨u, List.mem_range.mpr hu, ?_⟩
  refine List.mem_map.mpr ⟨p, Array.mem_toList_iff.mpr hp, ?_⟩
  simp [hp1, hp2]

theorem mem_sortedEdges' {g : WeightedGraph} {e : MSTEdge} (he : e ∈ mkEdges g) :
    e ∈ sortedEdges g :=
  (List.mergeSort_perm (mkEdges g) (fun a b => decide (a.w ≤ b.w))).symm.subset he

theorem sortedEdges_bounds {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed) :
    ∀ e ∈ sortedEdges g, e.u < g.size ∧ e.v < g.size := by
  intro e he
  obtain ⟨hu, p, hp, hp1, hp2⟩ := mkEdges_valid (mem_sortedEdges he)
  refine ⟨hu, ?_⟩
  have := (hwf e.u hu).1 p hp
  omega

theorem initUF_size (n : Nat) : (initUF n).size = n := by simp [initUF]

theorem initUF_find {n i : Nat} (hi : i < n) : UFfind (initUF n) i = i := by
  simp [UFfind, initUF, Array.getD, hi]

theorem initUF_labelSet (n : Nat) : (labelSet n (initUF n)).card = n := by
  have : labelSet n (initUF n) = Finset.range n := by
    ext x
    simp only [labelSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; rw [initUF_find hi]; exact hi
    · intro hx; exact ⟨x, hx, initUF_find hx⟩
  rw [this, Finset.card_range]

/-- The bundled facts about the actual run on `graph`. -/
theorem kruskal_run_facts (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    let st := kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []
    st.2 = kruskal_mst graph h ∧
    st.2.length + (labelSet graph.size st.1).card = graph.size ∧
    (∀ a b, a < graph.size → b < graph.size → UFfind st.1 a = UFfind st.1 b → Reach st.2 a b) ∧
    (∀ e ∈ sortedEdges graph, UFfind st.1 e.u = UFfind st.1 e.v) := by
  obtain ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbnd⟩ := h
  obtain ⟨_, i2, i3, i4, _⟩ :=
    kruskalRun_inv graph.size (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []
      (initUF_size _) (sortedEdges_bounds hwf)
      (by simpa using initUF_labelSet graph.size)
      (by
        intro a b ha hbn hab
        rw [initUF_find ha, initUF_find hbn] at hab
        subst hab
        exact Reach.refl' _ _)
  exact ⟨rfl, i2, i3, i4⟩

/-- Every pair of vertices ends in the same component. -/
theorem kruskal_all_merged (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph)
    (a b : Nat) (ha : a < graph.size) (hb : b < graph.size) :
    UFfind (kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []).1 a =
      UFfind (kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []).1 b := by
  obtain ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbnd⟩ := h
  set F := (kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []).1 with hF
  have hmerge : ∀ e ∈ sortedEdges graph, UFfind F e.u = UFfind F e.v :=
    (kruskal_run_facts graph ⟨hwf, hpos, hconn, hbnd⟩).2.2.2
  obtain ⟨p, hp1, hp2, hp3⟩ := hconn a b ha hb
  refine chain_of_path (R := fun x y => UFfind F x = UFfind F y) (fun _ => rfl)
    (fun _ _ _ h1 h2 => h1.trans h2) p ?_ a b hp1 hp2
  intro i hi
  obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hp3.2 i hi
  exact hmerge ⟨p.getD i 0, p.getD (i + 1) 0, w⟩ (mem_sortedEdges' (mem_mkEdges hw))

/-- P1: the result has exactly `n - 1` edges. -/
theorem kruskal_length (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    (kruskal_mst graph h).length = graph.size - 1 := by
  have hpos : graph.size > 0 := h.2.1
  set F := (kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []).1 with hF
  have hcard : (labelSet graph.size F).card = 1 := by
    refine Finset.card_eq_one.mpr ⟨UFfind F 0, ?_⟩
    ext x
    simp only [labelSet, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_range, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩
      exact kruskal_all_merged graph h i 0 hi hpos
    · rintro rfl
      exact ⟨0, hpos, rfl⟩
  have h2 := (kruskal_run_facts graph h).2.1
  rw [hcard] at h2
  have hr : (kruskalRun (sortedEdges graph) (initUF graph.size) []).2 = kruskal_mst graph h := rfl
  rw [hr] at h2
  omega

/-- P3: the result connects the whole graph. -/
theorem kruskal_connected (graph : WeightedGraph) (h : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    is_connected_with_edges graph (kruskal_mst graph h) := by
  intro u v hu hv
  have h3 := (kruskal_run_facts graph h).2.2.1
  exact reach_path (h3 u v hu hv (kruskal_all_merged graph h u v hu hv))

-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem kruskal_mst_postcond_satisfied (graph : WeightedGraph)
    (h_precond : kruskal_mst_precond graph) :
    kruskal_mst_postcond graph (kruskal_mst graph h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  refine ⟨⟨kruskal_length graph h_precond, kruskal_valid graph h_precond,
    kruskal_connected graph h_precond⟩, ?_⟩
  -- !benchmark @end proof
